title: Book Two · Chapter 158: The Small Repair
story:
Dad holds the blue bike while Ronan turns the front wheel by hand. It moves a little, then rubs against the side.

“There,” Ronan says. “That sound again.”

Dad bends to look. The old bell hangs above his head. Ronan keeps his thumb away from it.

“I could ring for help,” he says.

“My ear is already here.”

Dad checks the brake and the wheel. He makes a small change, then lets Ronan try again. The wheel turns freely.

“New bike?” Ronan asks.

“Same old bike. One small repair.”

Ronan turns it once more. The blue paint has several pale marks now. Dad has raised the seat since his first ride. His legs still fit the bike.

“May I take it to the square?”

“After I check the back.”

They finish together. Dad puts the tools away, and Ronan pushes the bike through the green door. They walk the busy part of River Street before Ronan gets on.

At the square, Dad sits on the wall. Ronan makes a wide turn. He brakes near the tree and puts one foot down.

“You can come with me,” he says.

“On that?”

“You can run beside it.”

Dad looks at his work shoes. “They have other ideas.”

Ronan rides another slow circle. Then he sits beside Dad and drinks some water.

Dad has a work card in his pocket. He takes it out to check his afternoon time. Ronan sees two numbers. Dad crossed out the first and wrote the second below it.

“More money?” he asks.

“Less for this job. I need to correct one part.”

“Will Mr Sun pay you for that time?”

“Some of it is my mistake. We agreed on the cost.”

Dad folds the card. He looks tired, and Ronan does not ask him to explain the whole job.

“Do you want the rest of the water?” Ronan asks.

Dad takes the bottle. They watch a small boy chase a ball. The boy misses it, turns too far, and runs back with his arms out. Ronan and Dad both smile.

On the way home, Dad needs bread. Ronan waits outside the shop with the bike. Through the doorway, he watches Dad choose the smaller loaf.

At home, Mum has a full plate of cold noodles ready. She puts Dad's bread beside it.

“A new meal?” Ronan asks.

“Same old kitchen,” she says. “One small change.”

Dad laughs first. Ronan parks the bike in its usual place and follows him inside.

## 词句提示

rub＝摩擦；freely＝顺畅无阻地；cross out＝划掉；loaf＝一条面包。

## 理解问题

1. 蓝车的问题怎样得到处理？
2. Dad工作卡上的金额为什么变少？

## 读句子

**His legs still fit the bike.**

拆开看：His legs / still fit / the bike.

他的双腿／仍然适合／这辆车。
